title: Spinach and Feta Filo Pie
subtitle: layered with no folding
description: A crisp, golden family pie of filo layers, spinach and feta, baked in a milk and egg custard. Cut, scatter, pour and bake, then eat it straight from the oven.

steps.text: Steam the spinach in a frying pan with a little water, then set aside.
In a bowl, whisk the eggs, milk, 3 tbsp olive oil, a little salt and black pepper.
Mix the spinach with the crumbled feta.
Cut the filo sheets into long strips and separate the strips.

Line a baking dish with baking paper and brush with a little olive oil. Scatter a third of the filo over the base, pour over a third of the milk and egg mixture and scatter over half of the spinach and feta. Repeat with another third of the filo, a third of the custard and the rest of the filling. Cover with the remaining filo, pour over the remaining custard and dot with cubes of butter.
Bake for 30-35 minutes, until golden and crisp.
